title: Reader sign-in with Google, scoped to one publication
description:
As a reader, I want to sign in with my Google account on a publication, so that I can vote, submit and comment under my own name.

Notes: per-publication accounts (a reader of one publication is not automatically known to another); reader role has no access to staff models; guests keep read access to published content. Builds on PPY-58f107 (publication BFF with Prospectus accounts).

```gherkin
Feature: Reader sign-in
  Scenario: A guest signs in
    Given a publication with reader accounts enabled
    When a guest chooses "Sign in" and completes Google sign-in
    Then the guest becomes a signed-in reader of that publication only
    And the reader cannot read or write staff-only records

  Scenario: Reader accounts disabled
    Given a publication with reader accounts disabled
    Then no sign-in control is rendered and no reader mutation is accepted

  Scenario: Password sign-up is not offered
    Then no password-based account can be created
```

Prospectus #81 returns siteSubject. Remains: release the plugin and enable it on a real publication (Shipped), then verify a live guest-to-reader sign-in there. Kept open for that.
